name: micromamba

resources.checksum_source: locally-computed-pin from official HTTPS release; not independently authenticated publisher checksum

notes: Manager binary only; package environments need separately collected packages. Uses supported no-shell-init/no-channel-configuration options. Tests creation of an empty offline environment and command execution in it.
Upstream installer is fetched at build time from a pinned commit. No upstream script snapshot is vendored in the skill.
Installer repository has no established license grant; full script is runtime-fetch-only and patch anchors are kept minimal. Generated bundles require separate redistribution review.
